zapier.description: Use the apps and actions on your Zapier MCP server.

instructions.0: Create an MCP server in Zapier and choose Other as the client.
instructions.1: Connect your apps and select the actions to expose.
instructions.2: Open Connect, generate a token, and copy the full server URL.

zapier.placeholder: Paste the full URL from Zapier
zapier.urlHelp: The full server URL can contain a secret token. Paste it exactly as Zapier provides it.
zapier.authHelp: For a separate token, use https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connect and choose Bearer token.

arcade.description: Use the tools exposed by your Arcade gateway.

instructions.0: Create a gateway in Arcade and select its tools.
instructions.1: Choose its User Source and copy the gateway URL.
instructions.2: Paste the URL here, then sign in when prompted.

arcade.urlHelp: Copy the MCP gateway URL from Arcade. App authorization may be required the first time you use a tool.
arcade.authHelp: For Arcade Headers, use an API key as the bearer token and add the Arcade-User-ID header for the acting user.

composio.description: Discover and use your apps through Composio Connect.

instructions.0: Connect to Composio and sign in with your account.
instructions.1: Connect underlying apps in Composio when prompted.

composio.urlHelp: Paste the MCP URL from your existing Composio session. If it requires headers, add them under Change.
composio.authHelp: Session URLs and headers come from your external Composio setup. Direct-tools sessions expose individual actions.

executor.description: Run tools through your Executor workspace.

instructions.0: Connect your apps and configure action policies in Executor.
instructions.1: Open Integrations and copy the URL under “Connect an agent”.
instructions.2: Paste it here and sign in when prompted.

executor.placeholder: Paste your Executor workspace MCP URL
executor.urlHelp: Use the hosted workspace URL or a self-hosted HTTP endpoint reachable from Paperclip. The server’s endpoint policy also applies.
executor.authHelp: Keep any options in the copied URL. If using an API key, use a user key; workspace and organization keys cannot open an MCP session.

accountChoice.title: Connect {{provider}}
accountChoice.description: Use an existing connection or connect a new account. Existing access stays unchanged.
accountChoice.externalBanner: {{provider}} is an external service that handles the connection and requests to {{service}}. Reusing this account does not yet verify app access; the agent will check it and guide any additional authorization.

designExample.notice: Design example only. Review the interactive states in Storybook → Apps / Connections. No credentials are saved or sent.

management.title: Connection settings
management.confirmDescription: Delete this connection’s saved credentials and stop further calls through Paperclip. Other connections are unaffected. Actions already sent to the provider may still complete. Connecting again requires a new sign-in or key.

production.credentialsRetained: Saved credentials are retained when these fields are left blank. Enter a replacement only to change them.
production.includeRequestingAgent: Include the requesting agent or choose all agents to continue this task.
production.headerIncomplete: Enter both a name and value for each header.
production.consoleUrlInvalid: Use an HTTPS console URL without credentials.
production.signInBlocked: Paperclip couldn’t open sign-in. Use the sign-in link below to continue.

setup.boundary: Paperclip controls access to the tools listed here. App and action permissions inside these tools are managed in

invalidUrl.title: Enter a valid MCP URL
invalidUrl.body: Paste the complete server URL, including https:// or http://. A dashboard page is not an MCP endpoint.

oauthFailed.title: {{provider}} couldn’t connect
oauthFailed.body: Authorization did not complete. Your saved connection is still here, so you can try again.

rejected.title: Credentials were rejected
rejected.body: Check or replace the credentials from {{provider}}, then reconnect. Your agent access and tool choices are preserved.

unreachable.title: Paperclip could not reach this server
unreachable.body: Check that the endpoint is running and reachable from Paperclip, then try again. Your draft is still here.

setup.consoleUrlHelp: The URL of your Executor organization’s integrations page. Used to open and manage imported accounts.

subtitle.onYourBehalf: Paperclip will use {{provider}} on your behalf.
subtitle.readyToResume: Your {{provider}} setup is ready to resume.

setup.upstreamBanner: {{provider}} handles the connection and requests to {{service}}.
setup.upstreamComposio: After connecting this account, sign in to the app in Composio.
setup.upstreamOther: Manage app sign-in in the provider, then refresh your gateway here.
setup.finishSignInBody: Complete sign-in in the provider window, then return here. Paperclip is waiting for confirmation.
setup.windowDidNotOpen: If a window did not open,
setup.cancelled: Connection cancelled. Your setup details are preserved; try again when you are ready.
setup.bearerHelp: Paste the token only, without the word Bearer. It is kept in the connection’s credentials.
setup.disconnectedBody: Agents cannot use this connection. Reconnect to restore access under the saved permission choices.
setup.refreshHint: Refresh the catalog after changing tools in {{provider}}. Existing Off and Ask first choices are preserved.
setup.draftKept: Your access choices and setup progress are kept with this connection.
